ValidationRule.description: Service Request cases should be Closed with Service Request status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Case_Validation_Bypass__c.Bypass_Validation__c), AND( ISPICKVAL(CaseCategory__c, 'Service Request'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'New')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'In Progress')), ISBLANK(ParentId), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'Closed with Service Request')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Service Request cases should be Closed with Service Request status.
